paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the win rate of GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini. The chart contains four slices, each representing a different model. The slice labeled “Mistral” is a light blue color and occupies approximately 88.0% of the chart. The slice labeled “LLaMA” is also a light blue color and takes up roughly 80.4% of the chart. A darker blue slice represents “GPT-4o” and equates to around 19.6%, while another “GPT-4o” slice is a reddish-brown color, comprising around 12.0% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and lines extend from each slice to its corresponding label. The slices appear to be ordered by decreasing size, beginning with Mistral and then LLaMA, before showing GPT-4o in both a larger and a smaller segment.
